enrichment method: acetylated proteins were immunoprecipitated (PTMScan® Acetyl-Lysine Motif [Ac-K] Kit #13416, Cell Signaling)
fractionation method: peptides were resolubilized and separated via a reversed-phase column
instrument: analyzed using an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer
labeling: analyzed using an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer
reduction reagent: treating 10 mg of protein lysate with TCEP
